resource_audit.road1_rss_note: Road 1 peak RSS hit 7.66 GB due to step4_mod_rules_and_sim.load_calendars_and_bars loading full 5M-row a_daily alongside MTM builders in the same process.

executive_verdict.road1_nonwinners_diagnosis: 1to2, 2to3, 3to4, high degrade under symmetric +-10..20 delta patches because V20.0 already uses ultra-tight 18..41 atomic gates; symmetric delta pulls marginal non-qualifiers over threshold and displaces core S/A picks. pry is essentially flat (1.50x -> 1.59x at d=10 Guarded).
executive_verdict.road2_verdict: Cross-strategy unified scoring on raw 4,183 candidates loses decisively to V20.0 (best R2_Mech_Plus_Dyn20x19 top30 = 32.98x, all_cands = 13.23x vs V20.0 611,729.55x). Even R2_OrigPassOnly_MechDyn (all_cands, n=220) gets 72,839.92x (MDD 36.78% vs V20 47.32%), ~8.4x below V20.0 because V20.0 fine-tier priority + S-tier 09:35 conditional reserve captures far higher intraday convexity. Dyn20x19 improves raw Road 2 top30 from 17.21x (Base37) and 7.75x (Mech130) to 32.98x.
